audit.whatIsWrong: Two things, both already settled on the mirror page. (1) The content layer calls Vault a knockback twice — 'you Vault in, knock back' and 'dash-knockback over him'. Vault does not displace Zac: it dashes to him, slows, briefly interrupts, and lands Quinn near her max attack range. (2) Heightened Senses (W) is never mentioned as an answer to Elastic Slingshot from fog, which is the single most useful interaction in the lane.
audit.why: Quinn's E text says she 'leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it' — an interrupt, not a knockback, and that interrupt is what cancels a charging Elastic Slingshot. Heightened Senses is a 2100-range area reveal on 50s at rank 1; Elastic Slingshot is a 300-range charge he wants to fire out of unwarded fog.
audit.corrected: Vault's brief interrupt cancels the Slingshot charge and lands you at max range; Heightened Senses reveals 2100 units on a 50s cooldown, so you see the wind-up before it happens.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill/Quinn/Quinn/Skill/Skill/Quinn/Quinn — Level 1, Levels 4-5 and Level 6 marked even, and the 2+ item row given to Quinn.
audit.why: 54.79% over 261 games and the packet chart is Quinn rows 0-5, Skill row 6. Every why on the page agrees with the packet and not with the row: whys[0] 'you out-range him', whys[3] 'you convert the poke lead into plates', whys[4] 'R gives you roam tempo', whys[6] 'the lane evens out'.
audit.corrected: Quinn rows 0-5, Skill row 6, both layers.

audit.why: Spikes hold, and the mirror agrees Behind Enemy Lines is a travel ultimate rather than a duelling one — spikes[1] already says exactly that. Elastic Slingshot falling from 21s to 9s across ranks is why his engage threat compounds rather than his stats.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block carried no numbers.
audit.why: Elastic Slingshot 21s at rank 1 and 9s maxed, Unstable Matter every 5s for percent max health, Let's Bounce 120s at rank 1 — those are the three clocks.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d are template filler that never mention blobs or the Slingshot knockup their headings promise.
audit.corrected: Cell Division body for 'Let him eat blobs'; Slingshot body for 'Get E-knocked-up'.

edits.before: Zac has to walk into melee range to CS, and every step gives you free Harrier-marked autos plus a Q to the face. Land Blinding Assault when he winds up his Q stretch-punch and his damage falls off a cliff. The one thing to respect is his passive — if you let him collect the blobs he drops, he heals back everything you poked, so keep autoing him off them and shove the wave so he can't farm and recover.
edits.after: Zac has to walk into melee range to CS, and every step gives you free Harrier-marked autos plus a Q to the face. Land Blinding Assault on the Stretching Strikes wind-up — it is an auto reset, so the wind-up is the tell. The one thing to respect is Cell Division: if he collects the blobs he drops, he heals back everything you poked, so keep autoing him off them and shove so he cannot farm and recover.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are your snowball window. Your Q cooldown drops and your Vault (E) is both your Harrier-refresh burst and your panic button for his E sling — bait the sling, then dash-knockback over him and walk away with your attack-speed steroid (W) up. At 6 do NOT try to solo-kill with R; use it to roam the instant he shoves or backs, because a roamed kill bot is worth more than dueling a tank who just buys HP.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are your snowball window. Vault (E) is both your Harrier-refresh burst and your answer to Elastic Slingshot — its brief interrupt cancels the charge, so vault him mid-wind-up and land at max range with your steroid up. Heightened Senses reveals 2100 units on a 50s cooldown, so pop it before he can slingshot out of fog. At 6 roam with R rather than duelling a tank who buys HP.

edits.before: Hold E (Vault) for his E sling engage so you dash-knockback out and reset Harrier
edits.after: Hold Vault for Elastic Slingshot — its interrupt cancels the charge and resets Harrier

notes: The packet flagged 'Land Blinding Assault' in early as a probable wrong ability name — it is a false positive, the only difference from the kit string is capitalisation. Zac's Elastic Slingshot carries a 'grounding: shuts off enemy dashes' flag, but Riot's own description says nothing about grounding, so per the trust-the-description rule I did not write anything claiming it denies your Vault; that is worth verifying separately because if true it changes the escape advice materially.
